newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank buys dollars at 26.365 pesos.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank buys dollars at 26.365 pesos.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank sold dollars in late trade on Monday at 26.365 pesos, traders said.
Traders said arbitrage money has been coming in after the Central Bank raised its overnight borrowing rate to 11.50 from 11 percent early on Monday.
Another dealer said the Central Bank stepped in earlier to buy dollars at 26.366.
The traders could not give an amount of dollars the Central Bank had bought so far.
"Banks are just giving their excess dollars to the Central Bank," a foreign bank trader said.
Aside from arbitrage money, inflows are coming in for stock market investments, dealers said.
The local equities market staged a rally on Monday after a six-day losing streak.
